text:
Several power banks support Qi2.2 25W. Only two have US purchase details in my search results.

## Available to buy in the US

**Baseus PicoGo AM52 (10,000 mAh, 45 W wired)**
- **Wireless:** Qi2.2 at up to 25 W on iPhone 16 and 17 (not the 16e) running iOS 26. Older iPhones get 15 W. [Dealectric](https://dealectric.com/answers/qi2-2-25w-power-bank-released-2026-official-manufacturer) lists it as WPC-certified.
- **Price:** $59.99 at Baseus, or $53.99 with code AM52 (Dealectric last tested the code on 2026-10-24). [Notebookcheck](https://www.notebookcheck.net/Baseus-launches-new-Qi2-2-25W-certified-10-000-mAh-power-bank-with-slim-design.1223437.0.html) reports $79.99 on Amazon US.
- **Other specs:** 30 W recharge in about 1.5 hours, and it's allowed in airline carry-on.
- **Buy:** [Baseus PicoGo AM52](https://dealectric.com/go/baseus-picogo-am52-qi2-2-10000mah-45w). This is an affiliate link, so Dealectric is paid if you buy, at no cost to you.

**Anker MagGo 2 Pro (10K, Qi2.2 25W, active cooling fan)**
- **Price:** $109.99.
- **Availability:** It's a pre-order shipping Oct 21 to Nov 9, 2026.
- **Features:** A smart display, a built-in stand, and 45 W recharging.
- **Buy:** [Anker MagGo 2 Pro](https://www.anker.com/products/a110r-qi2-maggo-2-pro-magnetic-power-bank?Sort_by=Recommended&collections_anker-earth-day-sale-2026=&variant=46550444277910)

## Announced, but I couldn't confirm a US price or listing
- **UGREEN MagFlow Magnetic Power Bank:** UGREEN's [press release](https://www.prnewswire.com/news-releases/ugreen-pioneers-next-gen-wireless-charging-with-magflow-25w-the-worlds-first-qi-2-2-certified-power-bank-302505385.html) says it was the first Qi2.2-certified power bank. It was slated for Q3 2025 on UGREEN's site and Amazon. My results don't include a current listing, so search for it on Amazon or UGREEN's store.
- **ESR MagSlim Power Bank:** ESR [previewed it at CES 2026](https://www.prnewswire.com/news-releases/esr-expands-its-qi2-25w-wireless-charging-lineup-advancing-everyday-charging-at-ces-2026-302653572.html) as an ultra-thin Qi2 25W model. The release gives no price or release date.

## Not for the US
The CIO SMARTCOBY Ex05 Wireless2.2 Pro (10,000 mAh) is Qi2.2 25W, but it's sold in Japan in yen, per [CIO's release](https://prtimes.jp/main/html/rd/p/000000665.000043212.html).

For the best value right now, the Baseus PicoGo AM52 at $53.99 with the code is the cheapest verified option. The Anker costs about twice as much but adds active cooling and a display.
